title: Release 4.18.0 — static plan walkthrough
constraints: Python 3 stdlib only (no deps) for tools/

context.summary: Today /blueprint writes a single plan.md and the approval gate is an AskUserQuestion in chat. 4.18.0 adds plan.json as the single source, a deterministic renderer that emits plan.md and plan.html, inline SVG infographics, and a page you can review step by step. The live round-trip (change requests from the page) is 4.19.0.

steps.title: Write the plan.json schema reference and a worked example
steps.intent: Every later task renders from one structure, so the schema is fixed first. The reference documents each field, the validation rules (unique ids, resolvable depends_on, parallel steps never share a modify file inside a wave, every step has red.run and verify) and the size cap.

green.sketch: Write the reference from §4 of the design; copy its example into plan-example.json

steps.title: plan-render check — schema validator
steps.intent: A validator that fails loudly is what lets the LLM write JSON once and trust it. It cross-checks ids, dependencies, file conflicts between parallel steps, monotonic version, secrets (reusing magician-scan patterns) and the 256 KiB cap, exit code 2 on any error.

red.code: for f in invalid: rc, err = run('check', f); assert rc == 2 and expected[f] in err

green.sketch: argparse subcommands; load JSON; run rule functions in order; print one line per violation

steps.diff_sketch:
+ def check(plan):
+     for rule in (ids_unique, deps_resolve, no_parallel_file_conflicts,
+                  tdd_fields_present, touches_known, version_monotonic,
+                  no_secrets, size_cap):
+         yield from rule(plan)

steps.title: plan-render md — deterministic plan.md
steps.intent: plan.md keeps today's exact shape (### Task N, Parallel:, Files:, five TDD lines) so /orchestrate and /ward need no change on day one; deferred steps go under a separate heading and a sha256 trailer lets consumers detect a stale file.

green.sketch: string template per step; stable key order; trailing <!-- magician.plan/1 v1 sha256:… -->

risk.note: format drift would break /orchestrate parsing — snapshot test guards it

steps.diff_sketch:
+ ### Task 3: Stream rows instead of buffering

+ Files: create src/reports/stream.ts · modify src/reports/export.ts

steps.title: plan-render html — page template, tokens, player, map
steps.intent: The walkthrough page itself: one file, inline CSS/JS, PLAN inlined as JSON with </ escaped, CSP that forbids any remote load, light theme by default with dark as the same tokens, player controls, wave timeline, SVG architecture map, step detail and side panel, keyboard map, reduced-motion path.

red.code: html = render_html(valid); assert 'Content-Security-Policy' in html; assert 'http://' not in strip_json(html); assert html == fixture('valid.html')

green.sketch: TEMPLATE constant with {{tokens}} {{plan}} slots; the page you are looking at is the reference implementation

verify: open plan.html from file:// and run the 25-item checklist

risk.note: largest task; template is ~700 lines of CSS/JS inside a Python string

steps.diff_sketch:
+ TEMPLATE = r'''<!DOCTYPE html>…<script type="application/json" id="plan">{{plan}}</script>…'''
+ def render_html(plan, theme='light'):
+     return TEMPLATE.replace('{{plan}}', json.dumps(plan).replace('</', '<\\/'))

steps.title: Inline SVG infographics with applicability rules
steps.intent: Charts only where the plan has the data: tasks per wave, effort by layer, parallel vs sequential, blast radius, critical path, risk matrix, per-step custom. No chart library; each SVG gets a title, a desc and a hidden data table; series use patterns as well as colour.

red.code: assert '<svg' not in render_html(one_wave_plan).charts['tasks_per_wave']; assert all('<title>' in c for c in render_html(valid).charts.values())

green.sketch: chart_bar(), chart_donut(), chart_gantt(), chart_matrix() returning SVG strings; a rules table decides which run

infographic.title: Charts and when they render (plans in the fixture set)

steps.title: plan-render diff and all — revision summary and one-shot pipeline
steps.intent: diff produces the what-changed summary between two plan versions (used by the page's changed badge in 4.19); all runs check → md → html and snapshots the previous version into history/.

green.sketch: diff: walk steps by id, list changed fields; all: sequence the subcommands, atomic write via tmp + rename

steps.title: Rewrite /blueprint to emit plan.json and render both documents
steps.intent: The skill becomes a ≤ 8 KB router: read spec/research/kg, map files, decompose, write plan.json, run plan-render all, open the page (static in 4.18), gate with AskUserQuestion. New arguments: review <plan-dir> and --static. New grants for plan-render and kg blast.

green.sketch: Process section rewritten; references linked with ../../lore paths; fallback line for Claude chat (plan.md only)

risk.note: behaviour change in a core skill — eval blueprint-emits-plan-json guards it

steps.diff_sketch:
- 4. Write the plan to .workspace/shared/plans/<date>-<feature>.md
+ 4. Write plan.json (schema: references/plan-schema.md)
+ 5. Run `plan-render all plan.json` → plan.md + plan.html + history/
+ 6. Tell the user the page path; gate with AskUserQuestion

steps.title: /orchestrate and /ward read plan.json when present
steps.intent: Consumers prefer the structured plan (explicit waves, deferred steps excluded) and verify the plan.md trailer hash; when plan.json is absent they parse plan.md exactly as today, so older plans still run.

red.code: for s in ('orchestrate','ward'): body = read(s); assert 'plan.json' in body and 'plan.md' in body

green.sketch: One paragraph in each skill's input section: prefer plan.json, exclude review.status == deferred, check trailer

steps.intent: The page is checked against the acquired design principles by code, not by eye: computed WCAG contrast for every token pair in both themes, 44 px boxes on every control, a prefers-reduced-motion block, a title and data table for every chart.

red.code: for theme in ('light','dark'): for fg,bg in pairs(theme): assert contrast(fg,bg) >= 4.5, (theme,fg,bg)

green.sketch: parse the token maps out of TEMPLATE; relative-luminance formula; walk CSS for min-height/min-width on .btn

steps.title: README, PRIVACY, SECURITY, CHANGELOG, version 4.18.0
steps.intent: Users learn what the new files are and where they are written; the security scope lists tools/plan-render; the changelog carries the release notes; plugin.json bumps the version.
